premise: Rain patters on the big leaf while Archaeopteryx and Beetle shelter underneath, warm and dry; but the leaf fills up and bends lower and lower until all its rain slides off at once — SPLOSH — onto Archaeopteryx, while Beetle stays dry under his shell, and she laughs as the sun comes out.
inspiration: The overfull pot of folk humour (the magic porridge pot that wouldn't stop), turned small: the leaf holds all the rain it can, then gives it back at once.
lesson: A soaking can be the funniest part of the day.

en-US.title: The Leaf Full of Rain
en-US.text: {leaf:enter} {canvas:rain 0.6} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter, pitter-patter. Down came the rain. {archaeopteryx:enter} Archaeopteryx and {beetle:enter} Beetle hurried {archaeopteryx:go under leaf} {beetle:go under leaf} under the big leaf. {archaeopteryx:face happy} "Warm and dry!" said Archaeopteryx. {leaf:live bounce} Plip, plop, the raindrops bounced on top. But the rain kept coming, and the leaf filled up. {leaf:live droop hold} It bent lower, and lower, and LOWER. {archaeopteryx:face surprised} [nervously] "Er… Leaf?" Beetle knew what was coming. {beetle:live tuck} He tucked his legs in and sat flat and still under his shiny shell. Then, with one last drop, {leaf:live droop resume} the big leaf bent so low that all its rain slid off at once. {sfx:splosh} SPLOSH! Right onto Archaeopteryx. {archaeopteryx:live shiver} "Brrr!" She shivered and shook, drip, drip, from her beak to her tail feathers. {beetle:face happy} Beetle popped up, {beetle:sparkle} dry as a pebble. Every drop had run straight off his shell. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Then the rain stopped, and out came the sun. {archaeopteryx:face happy} [laughs] {archaeopteryx:live laugh} Archaeopteryx laughed and fluffed her wet feathers. "Well," she said, "now I'm the cleanest one in the whole valley!"

es-ES.title: La hoja llena de lluvia
es-ES.text: {leaf:enter} {canvas:rain 0.6} {sfx:rain} Plic, ploc, plic, ploc. Empezó a llover. {archaeopteryx:enter} Arqueoptérix y {beetle:enter} Escarabajo corrieron {archaeopteryx:go under leaf} {beetle:go under leaf} a meterse bajo la hoja grande. {archaeopteryx:face happy} —¡Aquí, sequitos y calentitos! —dijo Arqueoptérix. {leaf:live bounce} Plic, ploc, las gotas rebotaban encima. Pero seguía lloviendo, y la hoja se iba llenando de agua. {leaf:live droop hold} Se doblaba más, y más, y MÁS. {archaeopteryx:face surprised} [nervously] —Esto… ¿Hoja? Escarabajo sabía lo que iba a pasar. {beetle:live tuck} Metió las patas y se quedó quietecito bajo su caparazón brillante. Y entonces, con una última gota, {leaf:live droop resume} la hoja grande se dobló tanto que toda el agua resbaló de una vez. {sfx:splosh} ¡CHOF! Justo encima de Arqueoptérix. {archaeopteryx:live shiver} —¡Brrr! Tiritó y se sacudió, chorreando de la cabeza a la cola. {beetle:face happy} Escarabajo asomó, {beetle:sparkle} seco como una piedrecita: el agua le había resbalado por el caparazón. {canvas:rain stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Entonces paró de llover y salió el sol. {archaeopteryx:face happy} [laughs] {archaeopteryx:live laugh} Arqueoptérix se echó a reír y ahuecó las plumas mojadas. —Bueno —dijo—, ¡ahora soy la más limpia de todo el valle!
